name: Hope Gas Mason County pipeline
researcher_notes: Not an existing row (no Hope Gas, Mason County or Prosperity Line row in the 20261002 gas snapshot). Hope Gas, a West Virginia utility, announced on March 3 2026 a 30-mile, 24-inch natural gas pipeline, the first phase of a 250 million dollar investment, to serve the Monarch Compute Campus near Point Pleasant in northern Mason County. The operator release and a Marcellus Drilling News report agree; the operator is the origin for both. An American Intelligence and Power Corporation release from March 3 2026 confirms the pipeline name Prosperity Line and a construction start in April 2026. Meets sponsor, region and 30-mile length. Concrete step is a announced construction start in April 2026 with completion targeted for the end of 2026; no confirmation was found that construction began, so status is proposed. Start point was not found. The route is not published. A search result mixing in the Hope Gas Morgantown Connector (Wadestown to Morgantown, a separate project) was not used. Not checked: West Virginia Public Service Commission filing for this line, and whether the line is transmission class rather than distribution. Owner not in the gazetteer under an exact match, recorded as the sources spell it. No route research done. Confidence medium: single operator origin.
